scripts.pack:brixter: npm run build:brix-builder && npm run build:brixter && npm pack --workspace=brixter
scripts.publish:brix-builder: npm run build:brix-builder && npm publish --workspace=@brixter/brix-builder --access public
scripts.publish:brixter: npm run build:brix-builder && npm run build:brixter && npm publish --workspace=brixter
scripts.publish:packages: npm run publish:brix-builder && npm run publish:brixter
scripts.release:brix-builder:patch: npm version patch --workspace=@brixter/brix-builder --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync:brix-builder-version
scripts.release:brix-builder:minor: npm version minor --workspace=@brixter/brix-builder --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync:brix-builder-version
scripts.release:brix-builder:major: npm version major --workspace=@brixter/brix-builder --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync:brix-builder-version
scripts.release:all:patch: npm run release:brix-builder:patch && npm run release:brixter:patch
scripts.release:all:minor: npm run release:brix-builder:minor && npm run release:brixter:minor
scripts.release:all:major: npm run release:brix-builder:major && npm run release:brixter:major
